title: Create twelve bundled profile resources with binary embedding
description:
Create the twelve bundled profile JSON resources under Resources/Profiles/ and register this phase's sources and resources in CMakeLists.txt. This task is the serialized owner of CMakeLists.txt for this wave.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/Profiles/ProfileSchema.h for the exact required JSON keys and the validation rules the files must satisfy (schema_version, product_version, profile_name, author, description, base_parameter_values, macro_mapping, scene_values, tags).
- Source/Parameters/ParameterLayout.cpp for the authoritative parameter IDs, minima, maxima, and defaults. Every parameter ID and every value written into a profile MUST come from that file and MUST lie inside the declared range.
- CMakeLists.txt for the existing target names, source list conventions, and whether juce_add_binary_data is already used.

Work to perform:
1. Create exactly these twelve files, each valid JSON with schema_version 1 and product_version "1.0.0": Resources/Profiles/PrecisionRack.json, RapidDefinition.json, NeoclassicalFlight.json, WideArpeggio.json, SingingLead.json, DryCenterArena.json, LegatoSpace.json, DarkHighGain.json, BalladBloom.json, ControlledCascade.json, MonoRigPolish.json, BufferBend.json.
2. Each profile supplies base_parameter_values using only existing parameter IDs and in-range values; macro_mapping for all eight macros TIME, SPACE, DEFINITION, BLOOM, TAIL, FOCUS, WIDTH, CHARACTER with destination entries {"destination", "delta_min", "delta_max", "curve"} where curve > 0; and scene_values for exactly four scenes A, B, C, D each carrying eight macro targets, a mix target, a routing target, and a hold behavior. author is "nSpace Systems".
3. Descriptions and tags use behavior language only (for example "tight", "articulate", "wide", "long tail"). No artist name, no band name, and no song name may appear in any file, including in profile_name, description, and tags. These are engineering starting values, not final tuned values; say so in a short comment field only if the schema permits it, otherwise omit.
4. In CMakeLists.txt: add a juce_add_binary_data target embedding the twelve Resources/Profiles/*.json files, link it into the plugin target, and add Source/Profiles/ProfileSchema.cpp, Source/Profiles/ProfileManager.cpp, Source/Profiles/ProfileSnapshot.cpp, Source/Profiles/SceneManager.cpp, and Source/Parameters/MacroEngine.cpp to the existing plugin source list. Do not change the project name, version, formats, JUCE submodule pin, plugin codes, bundle identifier, or LV2 URI. Do not add any test file registration; task i.7 owns that.
5. Verify with: cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build build --target ShredSpace_Standalone.
acceptance_criteria: All twelve files exist: Resources/Profiles/PrecisionRack.json, RapidDefinition.json, NeoclassicalFlight.json, WideArpeggio.json, SingingLead.json, DryCenterArena.json, LegatoSpace.json, DarkHighGain.json, BalladBloom.json, ControlledCascade.json, MonoRigPolish.json, BufferBend.json

Every macro destination curve value is strictly greater than zero
